channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Fachin cita pressões e defende independência judicial
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin defended judicial independence as essential to preserving constitutional democracy, the rule of law, and fundamental rights, noting that threats can come from internal and external pressures. He emphasized that judicial autonomy is not a corporate privilege but a necessary condition for proper control of power and constitutional supremacy. The statement was made during a lecture at the Brazilian Congress of Law and Public Policies at USP.

item.title: Nunes Marques leva decisão sobre AtlasIntel para julgamento nesta 3ª
item.description: TSE President Minister Kássio Nunes Marques has referred his interim decision suspending the AtlasIntel 2026 voting intention poll to the full court for review, citing concerns that the survey's methodology may have manipulated respondents by linking voting intentions to everyday facts, such as alleged money requests from Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro. The plenary will rule on the matter on Tuesday, June 9, 2026, marking the first time the court has ruled on an electoral matter related to the 2026 presidential election since Nunes Marques assumed the presidency.

item.title: Janja chama Malafaia de “insignificante” durante evento do PT
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva called pastor Silas Malafaia 'insignificant' during the 4th National Evangelical Meeting of the PT, in response to his criticism of her meetings with evangelical women, whom he claimed lacked 'any woman of prominence'. Janja defended the meetings as an effort to listen to marginalized women and emphasized that 'every woman is important to me'. The event aimed to strengthen the PT's dialogue with the evangelical segment, which makes up 16% of the party's members.

item.title: Nunes Marques é aliado dos Bolsonaro, mas a AtlasIntel deve explicações
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques suspended an AtlasIntel poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro trailing Lula by six points in a hypothetical runoff, raising concerns of bias given his Bolsonaro appointment and perceived political alignment. The PL challenges the poll’s methodology, claiming questions referencing Flávio Bolsonaro’s audio request for money to fund a film about his father — using terms like 'scandal' — unduly influenced voter intentions, though AtlasIntel states these were asked in a separate, subsequent section. The controversy highlights tensions over poll integrity, judicial overreach, and partisan influence in Brazil’s 2026 electoral climate.

item.title: Flávio lança jingle com samba e diz que “autor” do Pix é Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released an AI-generated samba jingle for his campaign, claiming the Pix payment system was created during his father Jair Bolsonaro's government. He asserted that Pix 'won't be ended by anyone' and advocated for dialogue with the United States amid U.S. tariff threats over the system's impact on Visa and Mastercard.

item.title: TSE analisa recurso do PL e suspende liminarmente levantamento eleitoral da AtlasIntel
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, issued a preliminary injunction to suspend the dissemination and promotion of the presidential poll conducted by AtlasIntel, in response to a legal filing by the Liberal Party (PL) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling blocks the public release of the survey while the appeal is under review.

item.title: Na Parada LGBT, Érika Hilton pede votos para Lula e defende fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Federal deputy Érika Hilton (PSOL-SP) spoke at the LGBTQ+ Pride Parade in São Paulo on Avenida Paulista, advocating for the approval of the PEC that would end the 6×1 work schedule. She also made a public appeal for votes and continued support for President Lula in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve explicar elo com Daniel Vorcaro aos seus eleitores, diz Caiado
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that Flávio Bolsonaro, PL’s presidential pre-candidate, must explain to his voters his connection to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master amid potential campaign incidents. Caiado likened the electoral race to an entrance exam, where each candidate must defend themselves against arising accusations.

item.title: Representantes do TSE acompanham 2º turno das eleições presidenciais do Peru
item.description: Substitute Minister Nauê Bernardo Pinheiro de Azevedo, representing Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE), is part of the Electoral Observation Mission of the Inter-American Union of Electoral Organizations (Uniore) in Lima, monitoring the second round of Peru's presidential elections. The Brazilian delegation also includes TSE Presidency advisor Maurício Medeiros de Assis, supported by the Brazilian Embassy in Lima and coordinated by the TSE's International Affairs Directorate. The second round took place last Sunday (7), with vote counting still underway.

item.title: Lula veste camiseta e apoia Bancada dos Trabalhadores no Congresso
item.description: President Lula (PT) publicly supported the creation of the Workers' and Workers' Caucus, wearing the movement's t-shirt and posing for a photo on June 8, 2026. The initiative aims to increase the representation of the working class in the National Congress and state legislative assemblies.

item.title: Justiça bloqueia repasses do PL a publicitário de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Judge Danielle Paravani of the 15th Civil Court of São Paulo’s TJ-SP ordered the PL and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to deposit funds intended for publicist Eduardo Fischer — the new campaign strategist for the pre-candidate to the presidency — into a judicial account to secure payment of debts totaling 108 million reais. The ruling also requires submission of the Fischer contract, details of payments made, and proof of resource origin. A prior decision had already blocked payments to Fischer in a separate case brought by DFB Participações over a 114 million reais debt.

item.title: Presidente do TSE assina pacto com defensorias e diz que não há democracia sem acesso à Justiça
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, signed a technical cooperation agreement with public defenders to provide free legal assistance to candidates, voters, and electors in economic vulnerability, prioritizing cases of gender quota fraud, political violence, and electoral harassment. The agreement aims to strengthen access to electoral justice and consolidate Brazilian democracy by removing economic and structural barriers to political participation.

item.title: Após impor sigilo de até 100 anos em registros de bets, Fazenda recua e promete liberar acesso
item.description: The Ministry of Finance reversed its decision to impose up to 100-year secrecy on betting registration documents after media backlash and announced a task force with the CGU to ensure transparency in gambling authorization processes. Minister Dario Durigan stated that all completed processes will be proactively published, with personal data protected through redaction when necessary.

item.title: Dino aponta censura e cassa decisão do TRE-PR que derrubou post sobre inelegibilidade de Deltan
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino overturned a decision by the Paraná Regional Electoral Court (TRE-PR) that had ordered the removal of a TikTok post stating that former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) is ineligible due to his 2023 TSE conviction. Dino ruled that the post merely interpreted the court’s decision without fabricating facts, and that the TRE-PR’s ban constituted unconstitutional prior censorship, violating freedom of expression.

item.title: Daniella Marques ganha força para 'Posto Ipiranga' de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is openly favoring Daniella Marques, former right-hand of Paulo Guedes in Jair Bolsonaro’s Ministry of Economy and former president of Caixa Econômica Federal, as his top pick for economy minister in a potential future government, using the nickname 'Posto Ipiranga' — originally coined by Jair Bolsonaro for Guedes in 2018. The subscriber-only article highlights Marques as the ideal figure to continue the liberal economic agenda of the Bolsonaro movement.

item.title: Dino mantém remoção de vídeos com ofensa a adversário e fala em ‘bizarrices’ no discurso político
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino upheld the Amazonas Regional Electoral Court's order to remove videos by councilman Alexandre Salazar (PL-AM) using the slogan 'he will never be governor' against David Almeida (Avante), ruling it as illegal negative pre-campaign propaganda. Dino condemned the 'colonization of political discourse by bizarreness and crudeness' but acknowledged the phrase may be used if compliant with legal and ethical standards. The ruling imposes a daily fine of BRL 20,000 for any new publication of the prohibited content.

item.title: Especialistas criticam decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa Atlas e falam em censura
item.description: Experts, such as João Francisco Meira from the COP of Abep, criticized the decision by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the AtlasIntel poll showing a drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intention, calling it an act of censorship and unconstitutional. They argue the poll is already public and that questions about the Banco Master scandal and the audio with Daniel Vorcaro were asked after voting intention was measured, thus unable to influence the results.

item.title: Flávio sinaliza ministra mulher para a economia caso seja eleito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) signaled that, if elected president in 2026, he intends to appoint a woman to lead Brazil’s economy, also expressing a preference for a woman as his running mate. He mentioned three potential candidates for vice president — Simone Marquetto (PP-SP), Priscila Costa (PL-CE), and Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) — but declined to name economic team members to avoid exposing them to criticism. Despite the abolition of the Ministry of Economy under Lula, Flávio reiterated his intent to restore or replicate its function, citing support from allies of Jair Bolsonaro’s government.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio aciona AGU e acusa ministro de Lula de fake news
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, filed a request with the AGU to investigate alleged fake news spread by Lula's allies regarding the opposition's workweek reduction proposal. He claims assertions that the PEC would create a '7x0 scale' are disinformation and argues the text establishes flexible hours with proportional pay, preserving benefits like vacation, 13th salary, and FGTS. The proposal, approved by the Chamber and sent to the Senate's CCJ, allows individual negotiation of work hours, with hourly wages tied to the national minimum wage or sector floor.

item.title: O suspeito Flávio Bolsonaro pede contra o suspeito Alexandre de Moraes no caso Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested the STF to declare Justice Alexandre de Moraes's impartiality compromised in the case involving Daniel Vorcaro and Master, citing suspicious ties between the judge and the banker. The content alleges unexplained transfers of $60 million to the U.S. via shell companies, a $129 million contract between Master and Moraes's law firm, and message exchanges on the day of Vorcaro's arrest, indicating a potential conflict of interest. The narrative frames both Bolsonaro and Moraes as under investigation, creating a 'suspect accusing suspect' scenario relevant to the 2026 elections.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Sigilo de cem anos nas Bets! O que Lula está escondendo?
item.description: The Lula government has imposed a secrecy order of up to 100 years on authorization processes for betting houses in Brazil, blocking public access to documents from the Ministry of Finance, including opinions, technical notes, and analyses from the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets. Announced on Papo Antagonista, the measure raises suspicions about what the government might be hiding in the gambling sector, amid growing regulation and controversy over transparency.

item.title: Lei amplia regras de governança e transparência das Sociedades Anônimas do Futebol
item.description: Law 15.427/26 enhances governance and transparency rules for Football Corporations (SAFs), requiring independent members on administrative and fiscal councils, disclosure of meeting minutes and shareholder composition, and mandating a minimum 25% distribution of adjusted net profit to shareholders. The law also expands economic exploitation of football-related rights and aims to protect investors, clubs, professionals, and youth athletes. Presidential vetoes blocked provisions that would have prevented SAFs from being considered part of an economic group with the original club, exempted SAFs from the club’s prior obligations, and excluded transfers to the club from SAF revenue, citing risks to creditor protection and tax revenue loss.

item.title: Zema diz que apoiará Flávio Bolsonaro contra Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated he would support Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) against Lula (PT) in a potential 2026 presidential runoff, maintaining his anti-PT stance despite scrutiny over Bolsonaro’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro. He also confirmed talks with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) about a possible presidential alliance for a unified ticket, with decisions expected after the 2026 World Cup, and mentioned Rogério Greco as a potential candidate for Minister of Justice in his future government.

item.title: Flávio elogia SUS e responde se os Bolsonaros são machistas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) praised the Unified Health System (SUS) during a meeting with businesswomen from Grupo Voto in São Paulo, emphasizing its importance for the population. He also responded to accusations of machismo against the Bolsonaro family, rejecting such claims as an unfair generalization. The event served as a platform for the pre-candidate to the presidency to address topics such as gender and public security.

item.title: CEO da AtlasIntel cita reputação da empresa após suspensão de pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel CEO Andrei Roman defended the company's reputation after the Superior Electoral Court suspended the release of a poll showing declining voter intention for Flávio Bolsonaro. He claimed the firm is targeted when its results displease competitors, citing past attacks from both left and right. The suspended poll, based on an audio where Bolsonaro asked for money for a film about his father, had shown Lula leading in a potential runoff.

item.title: Girão critica indicação de Benedito e alerta para ‘meia delação’ de Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) criticized the nomination of Minister Benedito Gonçalves (STJ) as corregedor of the CNJ, citing concerns over independence and credibility due to his perceived activism in the TSE, including the cassation of Deltan Dallagnol and effusive praise to Alexandre de Moraes during Lula’s inauguration. He also warned against a 'half plea bargain' by businessman Daniel Vorcaro, arguing it would not yield new evidence beyond what federal police already possess and would instead serve to shield officials.

item.title: O voto obrigatório e a conveniente culpa do povo
item.description: The text argues that blame for poor electoral outcomes in Brazil is unfairly placed solely on voters, overlooking the active roles of parties in candidate selection, institutions in overseeing the process, and compulsory voting, which legitimizes a pre-structured system. Voters do not choose the best candidates but only those made available to them. Compulsory voting conveniently shifts responsibility that should be shared among all political actors onto the electorate alone.

item.title: TSE mantém inelegibilidade de Cláudio Castro, ex-governador do Rio
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld the ineligibility of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) for abuse of political and economic power, prohibited conduct, and illicit fundraising in the 2022 elections. The court rejected appeals, confirming its March decision, and stated there were no omissions or contradictions that could alter the judgment's outcome.

item.title: Por que o fim da escala 6×1 é importante para o governo e para a democracia
item.description: The debate on ending the 6×1 work schedule in the Senate marks the most significant labor rights change in Brazil in 38 years, backed by 70% public support and approved in the Chamber of Deputies by a large majority. Driven by the VAT Movement, the issue forces lawmakers to choose between business interests and electoral pressure in an election year, reflecting a global capitalist crisis defined by labor precarization and economic power concentration.

item.title: Nunes Marques endossa suspeita sobre pesquisa
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques of the TSE suspended, by liminar decision, the AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intentions for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after the revelation of his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro. The move endorsed suspicions raised by Bolsonarists about the poll's validity, sparking controversy over potential electoral interference.

item.title: Nova lei cria minuto diário na Voz do Brasil para divulgar canais de proteção às mulheres
item.description: Law 15.423/26, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, mandates that the Voz do Brasil program dedicate one minute daily to disseminate information about women's protection services, including the Ligue 180 hotline. Originating from Bill 754/23 by Deputy Lídice da Mata (PSB-BA), the measure leverages radio's broad reach and accessibility to combat domestic and family violence.

item.title: Atlas/Bloomberg diz que năo cometeu contaminaçăo metodológica após pesquisa suspensa pelo TSE
item.description: Atlas/Bloomberg denied committing ideological bias in a poll that showed negative impact on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign after leaked audio revealed him asking for money from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Although the poll was suspended by the TSE, the firm stated it adhered to strict methodological standards. The incident sparked debate over impartiality in electoral polling during the 2026 cycle.

item.title: Pessoas com dor crônica terão atendimento integral garantido pelo SUS
item.description: Law 15.422/2024, signed by President Lula, guarantees comprehensive SUS care for chronic pain patients and establishes National Chronic Pain Awareness and Combat Day on July 5, represented by the color green. The law requires prior disclosure of treatment risks and effects, awaiting regulation for full implementation. It originated from Bill 336/2024 by Deputy Bia Kicis, with favorable opinion from Senator Flávio Arns.

item.title: O que diz a AtlasIntel após suspensão de pesquisa que mostra queda de Flávio
item.description: AtlasIntel stated it respects the TSE's decision to suspend the dissemination of its poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro losing ground against Lula, but will defend the poll's legality and methodological rigor. The firm denies influencing respondents, noting the contested audio was played after the questionnaire, thus causing no contamination, and that the downward trend was also observed by other pollsters.

item.title: Crusoé: AtlasIntel responde a Nunes Marques
item.description: Polling institute AtlasIntel released a statement in response to a preliminary injunction by Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, which suspended the release of an electoral poll. The company said it is fully cooperating with the Electoral Justice, providing all requested clarifications and methodological information about the study.

item.title: A resposta da AtlasIntel ao TSE após pesquisa suspensa
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the publication of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro after claims that an audio clip of his conversation with Daniel Vorcaro was played to respondents. AtlasIntel CEO Andrei Roman defended the institute’s credibility, stating it has faced criticism from both left and right when results disfavored political groups. The poll showed Bolsonaro trailing Lula in a potential runoff, and AtlasIntel claims the audio was only shown after the main questionnaire ended, without influencing responses.

item.title: Flávio defende “modelo Bukele” e a construção de novos presídios
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advocated for adopting El Salvador's 'Bukele model' in Brazil, calling for harsher penalties against criminals and the construction of new prisons to reduce violence. He cited a 97% drop in homicides in El Salvador since 2019 as evidence and reiterated that groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho should be designated as terrorist organizations. The remarks were made at the Brasil de Ideias Mulher – Special Elections event, organized by Grupo Voto.

item.title: Em evento com empresárias, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula parece 'chefe do PCC'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed that President Lula (PT) appears to be the 'leader of the PCC' due to the Brazilian government's opposition to the U.S. designation of the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. The statement was made during an event with businesswomen on Monday.

item.title: A resposta do AtlasIntel após Kassio derrubar pesquisa que mostra Flávio Bolsonaro em queda
item.description: AtlasIntel defended the methodological validity of its poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro down seven points against Lula, despite a temporary injunction by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques blocking its publication following a request from the Bolsonaro-aligned pre-candidate. The institute stated the audio of Bolsonaro’s conversation with Daniel Vorcaro was presented only after the main questionnaire was completed, for analytical purposes only, and expressed confidence that the TSE plenary would uphold the study’s technical rigor and legality.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica ‘canetadas’ do STF e sugere ligações de Dino e Lula com o crime organizado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized Supreme Court (STF) decisions as 'pen strokes' creating legal insecurity, advocating for reducing the age of criminal responsibility and greater congressional support for structural reforms. He praised the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations and suggested that President Lula and Justice Minister Flávio Dino have ties to organized crime, accusing the government of failing to act against money laundering by these criminal groups.

item.title: “Depois de cada ataque injusto, a AtlasIntel se consolidou”
item.description: AtlasIntel CEO Andrei Roman defended the polling institute after the TSE suspended the release of a presidential survey, claiming that unjust attacks on its reputation have only strengthened it over time.

item.title: Justiça determina novo bloqueio de pagamentos do PL a publicitário de Flávio
item.description: A São Paulo court has ordered a new block on payments from the PL party to publicist Eduardo Fischer, consultant for Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, over a R$108 million debt claimed by an investment fund since 2017. The ruling requires the PL and Flávio to deposit owed amounts into a judicial account, disclose prior payments, and submit the contract, following a prior block over a separate R$114 million debt.

item.title: Moraes homologa acordo com deputado do PL e encerra ação penal
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes approved a non-prosecution agreement with federal deputy Sargento Rodrigues (PL-MG), who was charged by the Prosecutor General's Office for inciting crime and criminal association related to the January 8 anti-democratic demonstrations. The agreement includes 150 hours of community service, a R$5,000 fine, mandatory attendance in a 12-hour course on democracy and the rule of law, and a ban from social media, sparing him a potential 3 years and 6 months prison sentence.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa que perguntou sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended an AtlasIntel poll linking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal and Daniel Vorcaro, arguing the question sequence and wording could induce biased responses on voting intentions. The poll, released in May, showed a five-point drop in the PL pre-candidate’s 2026 presidential vote intentions. Marques ordered the institute to submit technical documentation within two days, citing the CEO’s admitted political bias in a CNN Brasil interview as further evidence of methodological compromise.

item.title: Fundo Eleitoral vai repassar quase R$ 5 bi a 30 partidos para campanhas em 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) announced the distribution of the Electoral Fund for the 2026 elections, totaling nearly R$ 5 billion among the 30 registered political parties. The Liberal Party (PL) will receive the largest share, approximately R$ 881 million, followed by the PT (R$ 615 million) and União Brasil (R$ 526 million), which together account for nearly 40% of the fund. The allocation is based on congressional representation, as mandated by electoral law.

item.title: Carol Cabrino, esposa de Marquinhos, relembra investidas antes de conhecer jogador: 'Me caçando de todo jeito'
item.description: Carol Cabrino reveals that footballer Marquinhos persistently pursued her on social media for six months before she responded, despite her shyness and concerns about his reputation as a womanizer. They met in 2014 when both were 19 and have been married since 2016, now living in Paris. The story was shared in the Globoplay documentary 'As convocadas', which follows the partners of Brazilian national team players ahead of the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que decisão de Nunes Marques sobre pesquisa abre precedente perigoso
item.description: Lula’s campaign expressed concern over a decision by Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, to suspend a poll showing declining voter intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT team warned the ruling sets a dangerous precedent for the freedom to disclose electoral data and could be used to pressure polling institutes. The incident occurred on August 6, 2026, at 15:31, raising alarms about the independence of the electoral process.

item.title: Por que PCC e CV ligam o alerta máximo das autoridades nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Criminal organizations such as PCC and CV are seeking to finance and infiltrate candidates in the 2026 Brazilian elections to expand their territorial control and influence public policy, aiming to secure state protection, facilitate money laundering, and alter legislation in their favor. Federal and state authorities have launched operations to block candidatures linked to crime and ensure free voting, as nearly 30 million Brazilians live under the dominance of these groups. The Senate’s CPI confirmed that organized crime does not merely seek to hold office, but to capture the State through institutional access and protection.

item.title: Credenciamento de armazéns agropecuários no sistema público agora é opcional
item.description: Law 15.429/2026, signed by President Lula, makes public certification of agricultural warehouses optional, allowing private certifiers to compete with the state system. Originating from Bill 4.676/2019 by federal deputy Covatti Filho (PP-RS), the law preserves the state’s authority to set technical and operational standards while removing mandatory enrollment. The Senate approved the bill in May 2026 following a favorable opinion from the Agriculture Committee in 2021.

item.title: EBC confirma saída de Datena da TV Brasil para disputar eleições
item.description: Journalist and presenter José Luiz Datena ended his contract with EBC after six months at TV Brasil and Rádio Nacional to run in the 2026 elections. His departure was driven by PSB's efforts to nominate him as a federal deputy candidate for São Paulo, in line with electoral law requiring communicators to leave media outlets by June 30 of election year. Datena previously ran unsuccessfully for mayor of São Paulo in 2024 under the PSDB.
